title: RoleMRC: A Fine-Grained Composite Benchmark for Role-Playing and Instruction-Following
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a benchmark for role-playing accuracy and instruction-following capabilities. While it includes 'System Prioritized Rules' that cover safety-related topic bans (e.g., mental health advice) and features a standard ethics statement, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
